starterCode:
# 掷骰子 600 次，统计 6 出现的频率
count = 0
for i in range(600):
    if random(1, 6) == 6:
        count = count + 1

say("600 次中开出 6 共 " + count + " 次")
say("频率 = " + count * 100 / 600 + "%，理论概率 1/6 ≈ 16.7%")

lab.code:
# 频率估计概率探索台（掷出 6 的频率）
n = 300   # 掷的次数

hide()
count = 0
i = 0
while i < n:
    if random(1, 6) == 6:
        count = count + 1
    i = i + 1
freq = count * 100 / n
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
go_to(-140, -100)
go_to(-140, -100 + freq * 2)
go_to(-20, -100 + freq * 2)
go_to(-20, -100)
go_to(-140, -100)
pen_up()
write("实测频率 " + freq + "%", -120, -125, "blue", 12)
pen_color("red")
pen_down()
go_to(-140, -100 + 16.7 * 2)
go_to(140, -100 + 16.7 * 2)
pen_up()
write("理论 1/6≈16.7%", 20, -100 + 16.7 * 2 + 14, "red", 11)
write("掷 " + n + " 次，开出 6 共 " + count + " 次", -190, 140, "red", 13)
diff = freq - 16.7
if diff > 0:
    diff = diff
write("与理论差 " + diff + " 个百分点", -190, 112, "orange", 11)
